items: Memorize the four categories of bills: Ordinary Bill, Money Bill, Financial Bill, and Constitutional Amendment Bill.
Competitive exams frequently test the procedural differences between Money Bills, Financial Bills, and Constitutional Amendment Bills.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Bills introduced in the Parliament of India are classified into four primary categories.
The classification includes Ordinary Bills, Money Bills, Financial Bills, and Constitutional Amendment Bills.
Each type of bill follows a specific legislative procedure as mandated by parliamentary rules and the Constitution.
